pages.text: In Refined Storage 2, fluid storage has been enhanced with improved efficiency and better integration. Storage disks now handle both items and fluids with enhanced precision and reliability. The main Grid interface provides unified access to all stored contents with better organization and filtering capabilities. RS2 features improved fluid handling and better storage management.

Available fluid storage capacities:$(li)64k Fluid Storage (64,000 mB)$(li)256k Fluid Storage (256,000 mB)$(li)1024k Fluid Storage (1,024,000 mB)$(li)4096k Fluid Storage (4,096,000 mB)$(li)Creative Fluid Storage (Infinite)$(br2)Each disk now features improved transfer rates, better reliability, and enhanced compatibility with other mods.
